info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Personal Loan Applications Submission API
info.description: This API facilitates the submission of personal loan applications for customers. It enables financial institutions to securely collect and process application data associated with a specific customer. Typical consumers include loan officers, customer service representatives, and banking applications that require the creation of new loan applications on behalf of customers. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their loan processing workflows and improve customer experiences through streamlined application submissions.

post.summary: Create a Personal Loan Application for a Customer
post.description: This endpoint allows you to submit a new personal loan application for a specific customer identified by their unique identifier. The application will be processed according to the defined business rules.

requestBody.description: The request body should contain the necessary details for submitting a personal loan application for customer CUST-100045. Ensure that all required fields are included to process the application successfully.

201.description: The personal loan application was successfully created.
